mentions.name: Plasma camera shader
mentions.description: A realtime shader that applies a plasma effect over live camera input, with a visual style reminiscent of Plasma Pong.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://vester.si/motion/?e=plasma

My new favourite shader running realtime over your camera input. Has gotten great feedback from kids as well :)

Knowers of plasma pong might see slight resemblance.
